title: Stable Behavior, Limited Variation: Persona Validity in LLM Agents for Urban Sentiment Perception

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing sentiment annotations of urban scene images generated by MLLM agents prompted with 'Low income' versus 'High income' personas.
Comparing sentiment annotations of urban scene images generated by MLLM agents prompted with 'Male' versus 'Female' personas.
Comparing sentiment annotations of urban scene images generated by MLLM agents prompted with 'Progressive' versus 'Conservative' personas.
Comparing sentiment annotations of urban scene images generated by MLLM agents prompted with 'Analytical', 'Empathetic', and 'Pragmatic' personality traits.
Analyzing the predicted sentiment distribution across conditions against human ground truth to detect the model's tendency to over-predict extreme sentiment categories and collapse intermediate ones.
